name: openaq-mcp-server
description: Find air-quality monitoring stations, read latest sensor values, and pull historical pollutant series via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

OPENAQ_API_KEY.title: OpenAQ API key
OPENAQ_API_KEY.description: OpenAQ v3 API key, sent as the X-API-Key header. Free from openaq.org.

CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.title: DataCanvas provider
CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE.description: Leave as 'none'. This bundle ships without DuckDB's platform-specific native binding, so 'duckdb' cannot start a canvas here — use the npm or Docker install for SQL analysis over large measurement series. With 'none', large series return a truncated preview plus a notice.
